name: Pork & Porcine Derivatives
aliases: pork, porcine, pig, swine, lard, pork fat, porcine fat, pork gelatine, pork gelatin, porcine gelatine, porcine gelatin, pork collagen, porcine collagen, pork broth, pork stock, pork extract, pork protein, porcine protein, pork rind, pork skin
what_is: Pork and ingredients explicitly derived from pigs, including lard, porcine gelatine or collagen, fats, proteins, stocks and extracts.
why_botia: BOTIA flags explicit pork and porcine terms because Codex CXG 24-1997 lists pigs and boars, including their products and derivatives, among sources considered unlawful for use of a halal claim. BOTIA detects declared ingredient terms; it does not certify halal status.
can_1: Identify explicit pork, porcine, pig, lard and related porcine-derived terms when they are declared on the label.
can_2: Trigger the Muslim and animal-origin information layers and explain the declared porcine origin.
cannot_1: Determine the source of a generic ingredient such as gelatine, collagen or animal fat unless the label states that it is porcine.
cannot_2: Certify or guarantee that a product is halal, or verify slaughter, processing, cross-contact or certification controls.

sources.label: Codex Alimentarius — General Guidelines for Use of the Term Halal (CXG 24-1997)
